license_required.quote: Every person who desires to practice medicine must first obtain a license to do so from the state board of medical licensure

issuing_authority.quote: obtain a license to do so from the state board of medical licensure

name.value: Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure
name.quote: the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure established under Section 73-43-1 et seq.

type.quote: the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure established under Section 73-43-1 et seq., acting through its executive director

moral_character_required.quote: If the applicant is found by the board, upon examination, to possess sufficient learning in those branches and to be of good moral character, the board shall issue him a license to practice medicine

degree_required.value: diploma from a reputable medical college or college of osteopathic medicine requiring a four-year course of at least 32 weeks per session
degree_required.quote: no applicant shall be granted a license unless the applicant holds a diploma from a reputable medical college or college of osteopathic medicine that requires a four-year course of at least thirty-two (32) weeks for each session, or its equivalent

exams.name: Board examination (methods deemed most practical and expeditious)
exams.notes: Board may also recognize National Board of Medical Examiners diplomates and waive examination
exams.quote: must be examined by the board according to the methods deemed by it to be the most practical and expeditious to test the applicants' qualifications

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners / National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons
exams.notes: Board may affiliate with and recognize diplomates of these boards for purpose of waiving examination
exams.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may affiliate with and recognize for the purpose of waiving examination diplomates of the National Board of Medical Examiners, or the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: Required for Interstate Medical Licensure Compact eligibility; must pass each component within three attempts
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three (3) attempts

interval_years.quote: the license of every person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Mississippi shall be renewed annually

available.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may grant license to practice medicine without examination as to learning to graduates in medicine or osteopathic medicine who hold license to practice medicine from another state, provided the requirements in such state are equal to those required by the State Board of Medical Licensure

requirements.value: Requirements in the other state must be equal to those required by the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure; military applicants and spouses subject to Military Family Freedom Act provisions
requirements.quote: provided the requirements in such state are equal to those required by the State Board of Medical Licensure. The issuance of a license by reciprocity to a military-trained applicant or military spouse shall be subject to the provisions of Section 73-50-1.

regulatory_model.quote: Every person who desires to practice medicine must first obtain a license to do so from the state board of medical licensure

credential_type.quote: obtain a license to do so from the state board of medical licensure

is_mandatory.quote: Every person who desires to practice medicine must first obtain a license to do so from the state board of medical licensure

scope_protection.quote: Nonresident physicians not holding a license from the state shall not be permitted to practice medicine under any circumstances after remaining in the state for five (5) days

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs or other addiction-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors to an extent affecting professional competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors, or any beverage, to an extent which affects professional competency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing narcotic or addictive drugs outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any narcotic drug, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability otherwise than in the course of legitimate professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating possession, distribution or use of narcotic or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring, attempting to procure, or aiding in an abortion that is not medically indicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or attempting to procure, or aiding in, an abortion that is not medically indicated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, a certified copy of the conviction order or judgment rendered by the trial court being prima facie evidence thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including practicing under false name, assisting unlicensed persons, fraudulent claims, dishonest practices, and other enumerated acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, which includes, but is not limited to: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner, living or dead.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension or other restriction of a license by another state's licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state or jurisdiction to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice medicine in that jurisdiction or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of a license or medical staff membership while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final sanctions imposed by HHS Office of Inspector General based on incompetency, gross misconduct or failure to meet professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Final sanctions imposed by the United States Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General or any successor federal agency or office, based upon a finding of incompetency, gross misconduct or failure to meet professionally recognized standards of health care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board or its investigators legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the board, its investigators or representatives information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Medical Practice Act or board rules, orders, or agreements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision(s) of the Medical Practice Act or the rules and regulations of the board or of any order, stipulation or agreement with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of provisions relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation(s) of the provisions of Sections 41-121-1 through 41-121-9 relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or inducing an abortion in violation of statutory provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or inducing an abortion on a woman in violation of any provision of Sections 41-41-131 through 41-41-145.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing an abortion after detecting a fetal heartbeat as provided by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing an abortion on a pregnant woman after determining that the unborn human individual that the pregnant woman is carrying has a detectable fetal heartbeat as provided in Section 41-41-34.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being out of compliance with a child support order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall be authorized to suspend the license of any licensee for being out of compliance with an order for support, as defined in Section 93-11-153

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental illness rendering physician unable to practice with reasonable skill or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental illness;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness including deterioration through aging or loss of motor skill
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skill;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessive use or abuse of drugs including alcohol rendering physician unable to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Excessive use or abuse of drugs, including alcohol.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in physician licensure and disciplinary laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in the physician licensure and disciplinary laws, pursuant to Section 73-25-29;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetency in the practice of medicine or surgery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetency in the practice of medicine or surgery;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by professional medical associations, licensed hospitals, or medical staff, or voluntary surrender of hospital privileges during investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having disciplinary action taken by his peers within any professional medical association or society, whether any such association or society is local, regional, state or national in scope, or being disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of said hospital

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine shall mean to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery, after having received, or with the intent of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any bonus, gift, profit or compensation
definition_quote.quote: The practice of medicine shall mean to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery, after having received, or with the intent of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any bonus, gift, profit or compensation

value: direct use of drugs, medicines, appliances, or other agencies
methods_authorized.quote: to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled substances in the course of legitimate professional practice
drug_authority.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any narcotic drug, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability otherwise than in the course of legitimate professional practice

license_status_types.quote: There is established a special volunteer medical license for physicians who are retired from active practice

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of foreign medical colleges approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates may receive a limited institutional license for practice in state institutions only; limited to 5 years; must pursue regular licensure including ECFMG certification
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure is hereby authorized and empowered to grant limited institutional license for the practice of medicine in state institutions to graduates of foreign medical colleges approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or its successor

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telemedicine practice across state lines requires a Mississippi license unless the evaluation/treatment is requested by a Mississippi-licensed physician who has already established a doctor/patient relationship with the patient
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The requirement of licensure as set forth in subsection (2) above shall not be required where the evaluation, treatment and/or the medical opinion to be rendered by a physician outside this state (a) is requested by a physician duly licensed to practice medicine in this state, and (b) the physician who has requested such evaluation, treatment and/or medical opinion has already established a doctor/patient relationship with the patient to be evaluated and/or treated.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of medicine across state lines (telemedicine) in this state, hold himself out as qualified to do the same, or use any title, word or abbreviation to indicate to or induce others to believe that he is duly licensed to practice medicine across state lines in this state unless he has first obtained a license to do so from the State Board of Medical Licensure

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with any and all states legally joining in the Compact in accordance with its terms

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: anybody taking action as set forth in this paragraph shall report such action to the board within thirty (30) days of its occurrence

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: a portion of which fee shall be used to support a program to aid impaired physicians and osteopaths

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the state board of medical licensure has reasonable cause to believe that a physician licensed to practice medicine in this state is unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of a condition described in Section 73-25-53, such board of medical licensure shall cause an examination of such physician to be made

investigational_drug_protection.quote: civil immunity shall apply to any licensed physician or licensed pharmacist who prescribes or makes recommendation to an eligible patient regarding prescription for or treatment with an investigational drug, biological product or device under the provisions of Section 41-131-1, and the State Board of Medical Licensure and/or the State Board of Pharmacy, as the case may be, shall be prohibited from taking any adverse action against the license of such physician or pharmacist based solely on the physician's action under the provisions of Section 41-131-1
